newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico finds six tons of cocaine in a truck.
newsitem.headline: Mexico finds six tons of cocaine in a truck.

text.p: Mexican police discovered more than six tons of cocaine during a routine truck search in Tamaulipas state, close to the Texas border, the Attorney General's Office said Wednesday.
It said the seizure was the fourth largest in Mexico this decade and that the 52-year-old driver was arrested with a 9mm Bereta pistol and four cellular telephones.
The brand-new truck had a container loaded with 417 brown sacks of cocaine, each weighing around 33 lbs (15 kg), and was bound for the border city of Reynosa.
Mexico's biggest cocaine haul in recent history was 10 tons found in the northern state of Chihuahua in 1990.
